ownerStatement:
丸い is a little busy; can we have two circular objects and two non-circular objects, using attention lines to distinguish the circular ones?
中 there is an existing Kiku artwork of Kiku in a box
上る let's remove the shadowed starting pose
日の出 let's remove the left part and reposition/resize accordingly
十台 let's do 3, 4, then 3 to make them as large as possible
広げる Maybe spreading out a map or equivalent would be more intuitive?
広い the objects are a little weird. Can we do rooms like a wide open room and a narrow cramped one?
明るい the emphasis should be on the whole scene, not the lamp
中央 it's ok, but I'd like to try something different. Can you generate several alternatives?
車内 nice concept, but the proportions are weird.
近い I'd like different objects.
夕方 Let's have all the time of day cards use the same scene.
同じ Can we do a play on the spiderman meme?
下がる/上がる I don't like the concept. Can you generate several alternatives?
入れる Ok, but maybe just one hand more clearly inserting, no shadow object.
作る ok, but I'd like to see several other concepts
回る is ok, but the shadow isn't helpful. It should have movement lines instead. I think it should spin the other direction.
立てる let's see some other concepts
止まる let's see some other concepts
出す same as 入れる but inverse
走行 lets' see some other concepts

directRevisions.concept: Exactly two circular objects and two matched noncircular objects; attention rays distinguish each circular object. No trays or extra objects.
Remove only the faded starting person; retain one solid climbing person, ladder and motion direction.
Exactly ten identical machines in three centered rows of3,4,3, maximized within a square with clean margins.
Hands spreading open one folded map with simple roads/river/green terrain, outward gesture, no words or duplicate ghost map.
A wide open room contrasted with a narrow cramped room, plausible matching furniture at consistent scale; emphasize wide room.
Same bright/dim room contrast; distribute attention around whole bright room rather than lamp.
Correct car body/wheel/roof/seat/dashboard proportions while retaining clear cabin cutaway.
Controlled near/far relation using a flowerpot beside a bench; same objects and viewpoint, emphasize nearer gap.
Play on duplicate-superhero pointing meme using two identical Kikus pointing at each other; same size/character/headphones.
One hand clearly inserting one gold ball across the rim of an open lavender box; no ghost ball.
Remove faded blade, one solid pinwheel only with motion lines and counterclockwise rotation, opposite current clockwise.
Paired inverse of insertion: one hand clearly lifting one gold ball out across the same box rim; no ghost ball.
